comment: One line, two languages: Go cookies.RenewalLine and utils.js renewalLine (owner ruling KA-5). `status` holds the renewal keys of GET /api/cookies/auto-status: names and times only, never a cookie value. `now` is the reader's clock. A jsOnly row is a payload Go cannot produce.
